title: Write a unique_items function preserving order
prompt: Write a Python function `unique_items(lst)` that returns a list of the unique items in lst, preserving their original order.

metadata.notes: Correct: preserves first-occurrence order — e.g. via a seen-set with an explicit loop, or dict.fromkeys(lst). A bare `list(set(lst))` is wrong because set order is not guaranteed to match input order. Graded manually.
